entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. I think... I think I need to make a return? I'm just so confused by the whole process.
I can definitely help you with that. To get started, could you please tell me the email address you used for the order?
Yes, it's confused-rider@email.com. I bought some cycling shoes but they're not right. I don't know what to do.

Thank you, I'm pulling up your account now. I see an order for the Pro-Gear cycling shoes, delivered about 35 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

I don't know if it's a fault? I put the cleats on and went for one ride, but they gave me terrible blisters on my heels. They just hurt so much. The website was a little overwhelming. Can't you just help me?
I'm very sorry to hear the shoes were so uncomfortable and caused blisters. That's certainly not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check the return eligibility for you right now.
Okay, I've just reviewed our policy. Since you received the cycling shoes just 35 days ago, you are still unfortunately outside our 10-day return window.
Oh, really? So I can get a refund? I was so worried I had missed the deadline.

Yes, absolutely. We can process a full refund for you once the item is returned to our warehouse. I am sending an email to you right now with a pre-paid shipping label. All you need to do is pack the shoes and the cleats back into the box and drop it at a post office.
Wow, that's such a relief. Thank you so much for making that so easy for me.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for all your help.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
